args.sql:
CREATE VIEW mv_account_influence_rank AS
SELECT 
    a.accindex,
    (0.4 * COALESCE(n.network_engagement_metrics->'connection_metrics'->>'connqualscore', '0')::numeric + 
     0.3 * COALESCE(m.netinflscore, 0) + 
     0.3 * COALESCE(n.network_engagement_metrics->'interaction_metrics'->>'interactdiv', '0')::numeric) AS nic_score,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (0.4 * COALESCE(n.network_engagement_metrics->'connection_metrics'->>'connqualscore', '0')::numeric + 
                                  0.3 * COALESCE(m.netinflscore, 0) + 
                                  0.3 * COALESCE(n.network_engagement_metrics->'interaction_metrics'->>'interactdiv', '0')::numeric) DESC) AS influence_dense_rank
FROM account a
JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN sessionbehavior s ON p.profkey = s.sessprofref
LEFT JOIN networkmetrics n ON s.sessref = n.netsessref
JOIN contentbehavior c ON s.sessref = c.cntsessref
LEFT JOIN moderationaction m ON c.cntref = m.macntref;
